Maya: Quick sync — Verdant Run case study timeline. Interview scheduled tomorrow 10am PT with Hana (customer). We need: transcript, one approved quote, and short B-roll from demo. Can legal review quote turnaround by EOD?
Jordan: Got it. I'll own recording + transcript. Will upload raw audio to Drive and ask for auto-transcript.
Casebot: Upload complete: https://drive.redwood/verdant_run/raw_audio_1768.mp3
Jordan: Auto-transcript looks ok but needs timestamps. I'll pass to Emi for redlines on technical terms.
Emi (product): I can skim tonight. Note: use `continuous batching` not `batching` in quote.
Alex (sales): Heads-up — we'll route inbound leads from webinar early. Can we get a 2-sentence customer quote for the webinar slide by noon?
Rachel (legal): Happy to review. Please paste candidate quote here or use this template: `"[Customer] saw a X% reduction in per-token cost and Yms latency improvement."` Legal prefers redacted numbers until approved.
Maya: Draft quote suggestion from Hana: "Redwood cut our inference cost by about 40% and halved p99 latency." Logging for legal.
Rachel (legal): Please change 'about 40%' to 'significantly' or send data proof. I'll ping Hana's rep for permission to publish exact numbers.
Jordan: I'll send Hana the permission ask now.
Maya: Also thinking a short webinar mention. Draft motion: 1 slide + 30s clip of Hana on stage. Alex, can you make lead routing form to capture demo interest?
Alex (sales): Yep — I'll spin up a simple Typeform and webhook to SFDC. ETA EOD.
Maya: Awesome. Status run-down: Jordan (recording + transcript), Emi (term redlines), Rachel (legal approval), Alex (lead form). Ping if blocked. :rocket:
